content.json:
# AppGW → APIM → Foundry Backend Routing Report

Full traffic flow from **Application Gateway WAF v2** through **APIM** to **Azure AI Foundry** backends. Use this workbook to:
- See when the circuit breaker switches traffic between **Primary (East US)** and **Secondary (West US)** Foundry
- Identify **why** a switch happened (429 throttling, 5xx errors, retry failover)
- Compare end-to-end latency by backend and layer

> **Circuit breaker policy** (from `circuit-breaker-multi-region.xml`): trips after **5 failures** (429 or ≥500) to primary within a 5-minute window. Resets automatically on successful responses.

content.query:
union
  (ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric="Total Requests", Sub="through APIM"),
  (ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where BackendUrl has "primary" | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric="Primary Backend", Sub="Foundry East US"),
  (ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where BackendUrl has "secondary" | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric="Secondary Backend", Sub="Foundry West US (failover)"),
  (ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where isnotempty(BackendUrl) and (ResponseCode >= 400 or BackendResponseCode >= 400) | summarize Value=count() | extend Metric="Backend Errors", Sub="4xx / 5xx")
| project Metric, Value, Sub
content.title: Traffic Summary

content.json:
---
## Backend Routing Timeline
Stacked area showing how many requests went to each backend per time interval. A solid block of **Secondary** traffic means the circuit breaker was open and all requests were failing over.

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend Backend = case(
    BackendUrl has "primary",   "Primary (East US)",
    BackendUrl has "secondary", "Secondary (West US)",
    isempty(BackendUrl),        "No Backend (APIM-rejected)",
    "Other")
| summarize Requests=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {Granularity}), Backend
content.title: Requests per Backend

content.json:
---
## Backend Switch Events
Each row is a point where traffic shifted to a different backend than the previous request. **Failover (primary → secondary)** means the circuit breaker tripped or a mid-request retry succeeded on secondary. **Recovery (secondary → primary)** means the circuit breaker reset.

> Tip: sort by `TimeGenerated` and look at `LastErrorReason` / `BackendResponseCode` on the preceding rows in the detail table below to find what triggered the switch.

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(BackendUrl)
| extend BackendRegion = iff(BackendUrl has "primary", "primary", iff(BackendUrl has "secondary", "secondary", "other"))
| sort by TimeGenerated asc
| extend PrevRegion = prev(BackendRegion, 1, "")
| where BackendRegion != PrevRegion and PrevRegion != ""
| extend Direction = case(
    PrevRegion == "primary"   and BackendRegion == "secondary" and (ResponseCode == 429 or ResponseCode >= 500), "🔴 Failover: primary → secondary (error re-routed)",
    PrevRegion == "primary"   and BackendRegion == "secondary", "🔴 Failover: primary → secondary",
    PrevRegion == "secondary" and BackendRegion == "primary"   and (ResponseCode == 429 or ResponseCode >= 500), "🟡 Recovery attempt: secondary → primary (failed — re-tripped)",
    PrevRegion == "secondary" and BackendRegion == "primary",   "🟢 Recovery: secondary → primary (successful)",
    strcat(PrevRegion, " → ", BackendRegion))
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    Direction,
    ResponseCode,
    BackendResponseCode,
    ['TotalTime (ms)']   = TotalTime,
    ['BackendTime (ms)'] = BackendTime,
    LastErrorReason,
    LastErrorMessage,
    ApimSubscriptionId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Backend Switch Events

content.json:
---
## Circuit Breaker Pressure
Left — **failures per minute to the primary backend** (bars exceed threshold = circuit breaker trips).  Right — **error rate %** per backend over the selected window.

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where BackendUrl has "primary"
| where ResponseCode >= 400 or BackendResponseCode >= 400
| summarize FailuresToPrimary=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| extend CircuitBreakerThreshold = 5
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Primary Backend Failures per Minute  (circuit breaker threshold = 5)

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(BackendUrl)
| extend BackendRegion = iff(BackendUrl has "primary", "Primary (East US)", iff(BackendUrl has "secondary", "Secondary (West US)", "Other"))
| summarize Total=count(), Errors=countif(ResponseCode >= 400 or BackendResponseCode >= 400) by bin(TimeGenerated, {Granularity}), BackendRegion
| extend ErrorPct = round(100.0 * Errors / Total, 1)
| project TimeGenerated, BackendRegion, ErrorPct
content.title: Error Rate % by Backend

content.json:
---
## End-to-End Latency Chain
The three latency layers:
- **AppGW P50 (ms)** — total time the client experiences (AppGW `TimeTaken`, includes WAF inspection + APIM + Foundry)
- **APIM Total P50 (ms)** — APIM's `TotalTime` (policy execution + Foundry round-trip)
- **Backend P50 (ms)** — APIM's `BackendTime` (pure Foundry response time)

**AppGW overhead** = AppGW P50 − APIM P50 (WAF + AppGW routing). **APIM policy overhead** = APIM Total − Backend. A spike in Backend with flat APIM overhead → Foundry is the bottleneck. Flat backend with rising APIM overhead → APIM policy issue.

content.query:
let apim = ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(BackendUrl)
| summarize
    ['APIM Total P50 (ms)']   = percentile(TotalTime,   50),
    ['APIM Total P90 (ms)']   = percentile(TotalTime,   90),
    ['Backend (Foundry) P50 (ms)'] = percentile(BackendTime, 50),
    ['Backend (Foundry) P90 (ms)'] = percentile(BackendTime, 90)
  by bin(TimeGenerated, {Granularity});
let agw = AGWAccessLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize
    ['AppGW P50 (ms)'] = round(percentile(TimeTaken, 50) * 1000, 0),
    ['AppGW P90 (ms)'] = round(percentile(TimeTaken, 90) * 1000, 0)
  by bin(TimeGenerated, {Granularity});
agw
| join kind=leftouter (apim) on TimeGenerated
| project-away TimeGenerated1
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Full Chain Latency: AppGW → APIM → Foundry  (P50 and P90, ms)

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(BackendUrl)
| extend BackendRegion = iff(BackendUrl has "primary", "Primary (East US)", iff(BackendUrl has "secondary", "Secondary (West US)", "Other"))
| summarize
    ['P50 Total (ms)']   = percentile(TotalTime,   50),
    ['P90 Total (ms)']   = percentile(TotalTime,   90),
    ['P50 Backend (ms)'] = percentile(BackendTime, 50),
    ['P90 Backend (ms)'] = percentile(BackendTime, 90)
  by bin(TimeGenerated, {Granularity}), BackendRegion
content.title: APIM Latency by Backend — P50 / P90 (ms)

content.json:
---
## Full Request Chain Detail
Individual requests with full routing information. `CallerIpAddress` is the AppGW internal IP (`10.100.1.x`). `BackendResponseCode` is what Foundry returned before any APIM transformation; `ResponseCode` is what the client received. Use `CorrelationId` to trace a specific request across APIM trace logs.

> Filter the table by `BackendRegion` or `ResponseCode` to isolate failover requests.

content.query:
ApiManagementGatewayLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where isnotempty(BackendUrl)
| extend BackendRegion = iff(BackendUrl has "primary", "Primary (East US)", iff(BackendUrl has "secondary", "Secondary (West US)", "Other"))
| extend FailoverOccurred = iff(BackendUrl has "secondary" and BackendResponseCode == 200, "Yes", "")
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    BackendRegion,
    FailoverOccurred,
    ApimSubscriptionId,
    ResponseCode,
    BackendResponseCode,
    ['TotalTime (ms)']   = TotalTime,
    ['BackendTime (ms)'] = BackendTime,
    IsRequestSuccess,
    LastErrorReason,
    LastErrorMessage,
    CallerIpAddress,
    CorrelationId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| limit 500
content.title: Full Request Chain — AppGW → APIM → Foundry (latest 500 requests)
